central_method_scope: DINOv2-specific frozen TEST K8-eligible acquisition-shift units
strongest_supported_claim: On the 10 DINOv2 K=8 units from the two frozen TEST categories eligible under the acquisition-shift protocol (fabric and walnuts), preregistered normal-only selective bounded threshold calibration improved mean balanced accuracy by 3.23 pp (category-aware 95% CI 2.70–3.76 pp) versus NoAdapt while mean FNR increased by 0.24 pp, within the +2 pp safety budget.
required_claim_boundaries: not monotonically safer with more support
